item.title: HomeAssistant - shrink a HAOS qcow2 filesystem
item.description: Mostly notes to myself, I hope they're helpful to you too! My HomeAssistant OS (HAOS) was originally thinly provisioned with a 30GB virtual disk stored in a qcow2 file. In theory, the file should only take up as much space as the virtual filesystem. In reality, it grows to accommodate the maximum size allowed. My HAOS was showing only 10GB used: But running ls -lh showed 32GB was allocated.…

item.description: Is anyone else SICK AND TIRED of the way hotels now foist plastic "keycards" on guests? No! I don't want tap to open my door! No! I don't want to keep the card in my wallet! No! item.title: Book Review: When the Dust Settles - Stories of Love, Loss and Hope from an Expert in Disaster by Lucy Easthope ★★★★★
item.description: This is a difficult but essential book. I was initially put off by how graphically autobiographical it is. The disaster planning I came for was frequently interrupted with the author's loves, disasters, health issues, pains, and domestic issues. As the book wore on, I realised how vital that is. Disasters - whether natural or caused by human actions - cannot be tackled in a dispassionate way.…
